items.title: "no cap"
items.body: means "no lie, for real." and "cap" means a lie. so "that's cap" = that's not true.

items.title: "larping"
items.body: pretending to be someone you're not, basically a poser or a try-hard. it comes from live-action role-playing in gaming.

items.title: "based"
items.body: when someone doesn't care what other people think and owns it. sometimes it just means "good."

items.title: "delulu"
items.body: short for delusional, like unrealistic expectations about a celebrity crush. it's also used in a cute way for people with big dreams.
